MEASURED 2026-08-09: the dessert is UNREACHABLE for two independent reasons, and neither is the judge's. (1) No dessert-soup concept exists in this corpus, so there is no entity for 'chè' to claim — no hearing was ever held and none is due (nothing was evicted; tea's row was never contested). (2) Even if one existed, an EXACT/alias link TERMINATES the span: the dense admission tier is reached only when sparse produced no link or a weak fuzzy one, so a confident exact grounding suppresses dense for that span. Park stays safe; fixing this is a CORPUS question (mint the concept), not a judging one.

Telex/VNI half-applied, iOS autocorrect mixes, one word typed lazily: this is NORMAL Vietnamese input, not a typo.
